# Physiopii - Modern Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation Platform

> Physiopii (https://physiopii.in) is India’s premier digital healthcare platform connecting patients with certified, experienced physiotherapists for personalized home visits and online consultations.

## Core Services & Treatment Specializations

- **Back Pain & Sciatica Relief**: Specialized manual therapy, core strengthening, lumbar stabilization, posture correction, and sciatica nerve decompression.
- **Knee Pain & Osteoarthritis Rehab**: Non-invasive pain management, joint mobilization, quad strengthening, pre/post-knee replacement rehabilitation.
- **Stroke & Neurological Rehabilitation**: Neurodevelopmental therapy (NDT), gait training, balance retraining, hemiplegia recovery, and fine motor restoration at home.
- **Cervical Spondylosis & Neck Pain**: Ergonomic assessment, cervical traction, neck muscle strengthening, and tension headache relief.
- **Sports Injury & Athletic Rehabilitation**: ACL/MCL recovery, ankle sprains, rotator cuff tear rehab, muscle strain recovery, and return-to-sport conditioning.
- **Post-Surgical & Orthopedic Recovery**: Fracture recovery, joint replacement rehab, post-operative mobilization, and scar tissue management.
- **Geriatric & Elderly Care**: Fall prevention, mobility enhancement, arthritis management, and gentle strengthening for seniors.

## Modes of Delivery

1. **In-Home Physiotherapy Visits**: Certified physiotherapists visit patients directly at their home with portable therapeutic equipment.
2. **Online Video Consultation**: 1-on-1 virtual consultations, exercise prescription, posture correction, and guided remote rehabilitation.

## Key Features & Platform Benefits

- **Verified Doctors**: Every physiotherapist is vetted with degree verification (BPT/MPT), specialization credentials, and background checks.
- **Flexible Packages**: Single session, 3-session, 5-session, and 10-session discounted care plans.
- **Progress Tracking & Digital Records**: Digital assessments, prescription tracking, and appointment management.
- **Online Booking**: Real-time slot selection, instant booking confirmation, and multiple payment methods.
